# The Jam App

> The easiest way to organize and run live jam sessions - no spreadsheets needed.

## What is The Jam App?

The Jam App is a free web application for organizing in-person jam sessions and open mic nights. Hosts create events, musicians sign up for songs and instrument slots, and audiences follow the live schedule on a public dashboard.

## Key Features

- Create and manage jam sessions with custom schedules
- Musicians register for songs and pick instrument slots (vocals, guitar, bass, drums, keys)
- Live public dashboard for venue screens and audience members
- QR code sharing for quick event access
- Spotify playlist import to build jam setlists
- Real-time schedule updates with DJ control panel
- Multi-language support (Portuguese, English, Spanish)

## How It Works

1. A host creates a jam session on the platform
2. Musicians browse available jams and register for songs
3. The host approves registrations and builds the performance schedule
4. During the event, the host controls playback order via the DJ panel
5. The audience follows along on the live public dashboard

## Links

- Homepage: https://www.jamapp.com.br
- Browse Jams: https://www.jamapp.com.br/jams

## Technical Details

- Built with React, TypeScript, and NestJS
- Hosted on Vercel
- Available in Portuguese (Brazil), English, and Spanish
